title: Disclaimer
introduction: A valid output still needs your review. File size, visible detail, playback and device limits depend on the source and selected settings.
seoDescription: What filecompresser does and does not guarantee: limits of browser-based processing, backup responsibility, and when to keep your originals.

sections.heading: Your files stay on your device
body: The public tool workflow reads and processes selected files in your browser rather than uploading them to a compression server. Website and engine code still need network requests. Local processing does not protect against a compromised device, browser extension or hosting environment. The Privacy Policy explains the scope of this description.

sections.heading: Keep your own backups
body: FileCompresser has no server copy of selected tool files to recover. A result can be lost when a tab is closed, reloaded or crashes. Your original file is not overwritten by the tool. Keep a separate original and save any result you need before clearing the queue.

sections.heading: Size and quality trade-offs
body: Some formats cannot be made meaningfully smaller at the selected settings. For ordinary compression, a candidate that is not smaller is discarded and the original is returned unchanged with 0% reduction, including its existing metadata. Explicit format conversions and ZIP creation can increase bytes and are reported separately. No result is padded, truncated or renamed to manufacture a saving.
Audio re-encoded to MP3 and video re-encoded to H.264 are genuinely lossy. They are appropriate for web delivery and email, but they are not archival replacements for the original.

sections.heading: No warranty of results
body: These tools are provided as-is. We do not guarantee any particular compression ratio, output quality, or availability. If a result matters — a document you must deliver, a video you must publish — check the output before you rely on it.

sections.heading: Browser and device limits
body: Available browser memory and processing speed vary by device. A large or complex source can fail even below the tool’s displayed input limit. Media jobs have a five-minute processing limit. A browser or device can also close a tab before the application can display an error.

A file extension does not guarantee codec support. Check the whole animation or video, listen to audio, and inspect PDF pages, forms and links. The PDF tool performs structural optimization without downsampling scans. ZIP safety checks are not malware scanning.

sections.heading: Not professional advice
body: Nothing on this site is legal, medical, or financial advice. This is a file utility.

sections.heading: Liability
body: To the fullest extent the law allows, filecompresser is provided as-is, without warranty of any kind. The operators of this site are not liable for lost files, lost data, corrupted output, or any loss arising from your use of the tools.
The application does not keep a recoverable server copy of your selected files. Keep your own original and check any downloaded copy before relying on it.

If you are relying on these tools for something contractual, regulated or otherwise consequential — filing a document, submitting evidence, publishing under a deadline — check the output, and consider whether you need professional advice first.
